skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA008
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA008. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.usage: A summery outfit that Rope supposedly got out of nowhere.
skins.quote: Looks surprisingly well-behaved, and is so— at least until she finishes her ice cream cone.

skins.name: Imp's House
skins.content: Witch Feast Series/Imp's House. A custom-made outfit for Rope that takes the young woman's activities and body shape into account. It utilizes lightweight and breathable materials, simple while not sacrificing elegance.
